caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #19: ACUMEN

acumen (noun): the ability to make quick, sharp judgments, especially in one field.

✅ In a sentence: Her business acumen helped the small bakery grow into a regional chain.
✅ Similar: insight, shrewdness, savvy
✅ Remember it: Latin acuere = to sharpen (same root as "acute").
